{{Top|leg}}
The '''Neutral Zone''' was the central section of [[Locus (settlement)|Locus]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nyriaan/Legends|Nyriaan's]] planetary government and only [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. The Neutral Zone was also where most of the planet's crime occurred, with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Kajidic/Legends|Kajidics]] and the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] roaming the zone freely.
